atomic_facts.fact: The grocery chain's full legal name is Trader Joe's Company.
Trader Joe's operates under United States jurisdiction.
Trader Joe's is headquartered in Monrovia, California.
In 1979, Aldi North (Aldi Nord), under Theodor Albrecht, bought Trader Joe's.
Aldi Nord is controlled by the Albrecht family.
As of 2026-10-01, Aldi Nord remains the ultimate parent company of Trader Joe's.
Trader Joe's agreed to a $7.4 million civil settlement.
The settlement was over claims that Trader Joe's receipts showed too many digits from customers' credit and debit cards.
The settlement agreement was reached in April 2026.
